summary: Busy residential kerb with parked cars; apartments 16-22 m opposite.

best_section.where: Ada Street north kerb, between the Cranmore and Lynwood apartment blocks

drivers.seclusion: Apartment blocks on the north side set back 13-22 m, houses across the road; no quiet side.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed street with parked cars along the kerb; room to stop.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, busier main road at the east end.
drivers.convention: Cars park along both kerbs all day, so a van blends in.

flags: Steep: about 6% grade at best section, 12% max
No Stopping Any Time signs at the east end
Apartments within 10-25 m on own side
sun_shade: Trees shade much of the kerb from the north; afternoon sun from the west along the street.
